verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a CDP SaaS platform like mParticle, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The pack documents client SDKs, HTTP APIs and an Events API OpenAPI spec for generating helper SDKs. Those are developer building blocks or adjacent surfaces, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
